actions-policy.title: Actions Policy
actions-policy.description: An Actions policy defines rules for workflow execution protection.

source_type.description: The type of the source of the policy

anyOf.description:
When workflow path targeting is available, detailed responses represent an omitted stored
workflow condition as `workflow_path` with `include` set to `["~ALL"]` and `exclude` set to `[]`.
When workflow path targeting is unavailable, an omitted stored condition remains omitted.

rules.description: An array of rules within the policy

href.description: The html URL of the policy

repository-rule-enforcement.description: The enforcement level of the ruleset. `evaluate` allows admins to test rules before enforcing them. Admins can view insights on the Rule Insights page (`evaluate` is only available with GitHub Enterprise).

actions-policy-repo-conditions.title: Repository Actions policy conditions
actions-policy-repo-conditions.description:
Conditions for a repository Actions policy. The object may be empty to preserve or use the
default workflow targeting, or contain only `workflow_path`.

actions-policy-workflow-path-condition.title: Actions policy workflow path condition
actions-policy-workflow-path-condition.description:
Parameters for an Actions policy workflow path condition. Omitting `workflow_path` when creating
a policy targets all workflows without storing an explicit condition. Omitting it when updating a
policy preserves the existing workflow targeting. For new or changed workflow conditions, the API
requires at least one included or excluded pattern. This is validated server-side rather than by
this schema, which can also describe existing stored conditions.

include.description:
Array of workflow file paths or glob patterns to include. An empty array includes all
workflows not matched by an excluded pattern. Use `~ALL` by itself to include all workflows.
`~ALL` cannot be combined with other included patterns.

exclude.description:
Array of workflow file paths or glob patterns to exclude. The condition will not pass
if any of these patterns match. `~ALL` is not allowed in this array.

actions-policy-org-conditions.title: Organization Actions policy conditions
actions-policy-org-conditions.description:
Conditions for an organization Actions policy. The conditions object should contain one of
`repository_name`, `repository_id`, or `repository_property`, and may also contain `workflow_path`.

repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository names
repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.description: Parameters for a repository name condition

include.description: Array of repository names or patterns to include. One of these patterns must match for the condition to pass. Also accepts `~ALL` to include all repositories.

exclude.description: Array of repository names or patterns to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these patterns match.

protected.description: Whether renaming of target repositories is prevented.

repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository IDs
repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.description: Parameters for a repository ID condition

repository_ids.description: The repository IDs that the ruleset applies to. One of these IDs must match for the condition to pass.

repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository properties
repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.description: Parameters for a repository property condition

include.description: The repository properties and values to include. All of these properties must match for the condition to pass.

exclude.description: The repository properties and values to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these properties match.

repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.title: Repository ruleset property targeting definition
repository-ruleset-conditions-repository.description: Parameters for a targeting a repository property

name.description: The name of the repository property to target

property_values.description: The values to match for the repository property

source.description: The source of the repository property. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

actions-policy-enterprise-conditions.title: Enterprise Actions policy conditions
actions-policy-enterprise-conditions.description:
Conditions for an enterprise Actions policy. The conditions object supports one organization
target (`organization_name`, `organization_id`, or `organization_property`) combined with one
repository target (`repository_name` or `repository_property`), and may also contain `workflow_path`.

oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by name and repositories by name

oneOf.title: organization_name_and_repository_property
oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by name and repositories by property

oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by id and repositories by name

oneOf.title: organization_id_and_repository_property
oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by id and repositories by property

oneOf.title: organization_property_and_repository_name
oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by property and repositories by name

oneOf.title: organization_property_and_repository_property
oneOf.description: Conditions to target organizations by property and repositories by property

enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.title: Repository ruleset conditions for organization names
enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.description: Parameters for an organization name condition

include.description: Array of organization names or patterns to include. One of these patterns must match for the condition to pass. Also accepts `~ALL` to include all organizations and ~EMUS to target all enterprise managed user accounts.

exclude.description: Array of organization names or patterns to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these patterns match.

enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.title: Repository ruleset conditions for organization IDs
enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.description: Parameters for an organization ID condition

organization_ids.description: The organization IDs that the ruleset applies to. One of these IDs must match for the condition to pass.

enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.title: Repository ruleset conditions for organization properties
enterprise-ruleset-conditions-organizati.description: Parameters for a organization property condition

exclude.description: The organization properties and values to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these properties match.

name.description: The name of the organization property to target
